author: Zintenka
body:
So, I've decided do a remix of Enoki because I personally love the map but I believe that it's gameplay needed a severe enhancement and I wanted to boost it up a bit - In my vision without deviating too much from it's overall theme.

After all, Enoki IS a mushroom. If I changed it to grass I might as well make a new map that's a rip-off, eh?

Features:
  • Reduced diamonds
  • Day and Night
  • TNT supplies
  • No more fake "Cores"; just monuments. It misled a lot of people.
  • Checks similar to OCN's "Filters". I'm putting this here so that OCNers will know what to do for their next map ;)
  • no-void regions. Self-explanatory.



IMGUR
XML
DOWNLOAD

I hope you guys enjoy the map, I've enhanced it a bit to make it available for public gameplay.

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Don't worry, I've fixed the spread out problem. There's a central hub of TNT supplies in the middle of each island which will provide you all that you desire...

I understand this, that's why I've added slabs to make it more smooth but I'll have to see about this after one gameplay.

I'll see what I can do about the side paths, I've moved the islands a bit farther from the center by a few blocks to hopefully alleviate this problem. I'll see after a few gameplays whether I should remove them or not

Thanks for the feedback

replies.author: lgmatias
replies.body:
Put diamonds back on the rings, there were too many before but now there are too few.

Also you should put other resources in the mid house thing instead of TNT because now there's overly much of it. I don't see concentrating resources as a good thing but I'm glad you left the extraneous TNT chests.

Oh, also I like the monument decorations because it makes cannoning them viable which usually isnt an option for a lot of cannon maps.

Also you should remove the bedrock in the mid hut.
